title: I Can't Review This Bike (Elves Falath Evo)

takeaways.text: During the build the mechanic found a rough-turning bottom bracket and a very tight seatpost; a second mechanic reported bottom-bracket shell faces not machined square and removed internal resin so the post would fit.

Elves agreed the pre-production sample's inner moulds were not ready and linked the bottom-bracket problem to painted frames; the creator also found it heavier than advertised and said he would review a mass-production frame.
A bike fitter judged the geometry a fairly aggressive but not unusual aero race frame; the raised top tube leaves little seatpost exposed, which he thought could make the rear ride a little harsher.
The wide top tube could touch the knees of narrow-hipped riders; the fitter expects riders with about 15 mm of knee clearance to be fine.
Reach changes only about 5 mm across sizes 52 to 56, so at 179 cm the creator chose size 52 over 54 for about 20 mm more exposed seatpost, restoring stack with spacers.

disclosure: The creator said in his January 2023 first look that Elves Australia supplied this pre-production frameset and wheels; the description links the guest bike fitter's business.
summary: A February 2023 account of why the creator withdrew his review of a supplied pre-production Falath EVO sample, with Elves' response and a bike fitter's view of the geometry. It describes that sample, not production frames.
